test_title: PYST 13: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 07 Aug, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the option that correctly expresses the following sentence in passive voice.**

Are you delivering the pizza?

options.text: Has the pizza delivered by you?
Were the pizza being delivered by you?
Is the pizza being delivered by you?

solution:
The correct answer is **"Is the pizza being delivered by you?"**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in the Present Continuous Tense and in Active Voice.
 
• The rule for changing a Present Continuous Tense from Active voice to Passive voice or Passive to Active Voice:
 
• Interchange the object and subject with each other, i.e. object of the active sentence become the subject of the passive sentence.
 
• Structure: 
 
 
• Is/am/are + Subject + v1 + ing+ object? (Active Voice)__
 
• Is/am/are + Object + was/were + being + V3 + by Subject? __(Passive Voice)__ 
 
 
 
• Example: 
 
 
• *Was Esha singing a song?** *(Active Voice)
 
• *Was a song being sung by Esha?** *(Passive Voice)
 
 
 
• The subject of the given sentence is 'you'.​​
 
• The object of the given sentence is 'pizza'. 
 
• The subject will be put in place of the object and the object will be put in place of the subject.
 
• And 'Is delivering' will be changed into 'is being delivering'. 
 
• "Pizza" is a singular subject, so we must "is" with it.
 
• The correct answer is option 4.

Correct sentence: *Is the pizza being delivered by you?*
